description: Four user-provided output screenshots, privately correlated with one retained genuine canvas review. These are not newly executed TEST captures.
captureTime: Unknown for all four originals. Visible report/notification analysis timestamps and the parent's preservation timestamp do not establish screenshot capture time.
sourceLines: Accepted screen assessment covers an 80-line prefix of a 326-line screen; later source remains unreviewed.
mainAndAssessmentCompleteness: Complete retained redacted MAIN and the sole complete accepted C4 report body are included unchanged, with full redacted inventory and coverage appendices. No accepted C1/C2/C3/C5 report is available. Screenshot viewports are excerpts, not complete reports.

screenshots.caption: User-provided review-notification body excerpt: Partial, five supplied excerpts, one saved assessment and four unavailable. Source filename is privacy-masked. This is not a TEST browser capture.
screenshots.correlation: The visible uniquely named source copy, version 1.0, completion timestamp, 5/1/4 counts, 22 omission records and 23 inventory records match retained private run evidence.
screenshots.evidenceBoundary: No sender, recipient, mailbox, folder or message identity is visible. This does not verify original owner Inbox receipt or recipient containment.

screenshots.caption: User-provided MAIN opening and sections 1–3, including Partial status, scope and inventory limitations. Browser chrome and private identities/paths are cropped or masked; the complete redacted MAIN text is supplied separately.
screenshots.correlation: The original visibly contains the exact retained job/report URL, source filename, source file identity, job ID and MAIN conversation, and matches the retained report header and substantive opening.
screenshots.evidenceBoundary: This proves displayed retained-report identity, not capture time or a new runtime execution. The native viewport clips some long right-hand lines.

screenshots.caption: User-provided MAIN sections 4–8: accepted C4 scope, four unavailable assessments, source observations, historical checker, suggested next steps and no confirmed strengths. Private bindings/paths are masked.
screenshots.correlation: Visible text, C4 source path, failed-pass list, seven source observations and historical-checker section match the retained MAIN. This image contains no independent complete job identifier; correlation is by retained document content and the user-provided companion images.
screenshots.evidenceBoundary: Not an independently authenticated job capture or a complete standalone report. Native right-edge clipping is preserved.

screenshots.caption: User-provided MAIN sections 8–10: no confirmed strengths, three NOT RUN verification checks, omissions and next actions. Private data-source names are masked; the lower private report-link/footer area is cropped.
screenshots.correlation: Three exact NOT RUN verification topics, omissions and the end-of-report marker match the retained MAIN. No intact independent job identifier is used from this image; correlation is by retained document content and companion images.
screenshots.evidenceBoundary: Recommendations are unexecuted report content. Neither this image nor this curation ran the source application, workflow, checks or another review.

mailReceipt: The user-provided notification-body excerpt matches the run's source and counts, but shows no recipient/mailbox/folder headers. Original owner Inbox receipt and delivery containment remain unverified; no new send or mailbox investigation occurred.
semanticCaveats: Partial does not establish release readiness or app certification; zero confirmed findings is not a clean bill of health.
Syntactically valid wording in the original report is not a compiler or Power Fx semantic-parser result.
Embedded checker records are historical with unknown age; publication-time wording does not establish a timestamp. Levels are custom checker properties, not normalized standard SARIF result levels.
Verification suggestions and next actions are NOT RUN; this curation did not import or execute the app or workflow.
Failed/unavailable component labels are pipeline results, not confirmed application defects. Phase labels must not be counted as additional model calls.
privacy: Browser URLs, private owner/site/agent/job/conversation/file identities, source paths and private data-source/schema bindings are masked/cropped. No originals, raw source, solution ZIP, role configuration, diagnostics or unrelated mailbox/automatic-reply content are included.
pixelIntegrity: Every output pixel equals the corresponding original pixel except documented opaque privacy-mask rectangles; only documented crop rectangles are removed. No report text was recreated, corrected or spliced.

publicDerivativeApproval.scope: Parent-approved public derivatives of this exact real canvas review; not production, compiler, complete-application or runtime certification.
publicDerivativeApproval.parentReview: Parent read complete redacted MAIN and both provenance records, verified fourteen pins and performed scoped restricted-context/private-binding/URL/email/credential screening with zero matches.
publicDerivativeApproval.siteReview: Normal derivative visual/privacy review of the eight approved images. Site author did not inspect private originals or independently repeat the original-to-derivative pixel comparison.
publicDerivativeApproval.bodyPolicy: All four TXT files, including BOM, complete coverage, claims, quotes, redactions and footer/unavailable records, remain byte-identical to the approved inputs.
publicDerivativeApproval.imagePolicy: All eight image payloads remain byte-identical. Four user-provided images are not TEST captures; their capture times remain unknown.
publicDerivativeApproval.deliveryBoundary: One guarded SendEmailV2 succeeded. Original owner Inbox receipt and recipient containment remain unverified after observed forwarding/autoreply. The user-provided notification body is not proof of verified Inbox receipt or single delivery.
publicDerivativeApproval.hostingBoundary: Public derivative approval is distinct from hosting/deployment; hosting state is recorded separately in content.json.

originalQaFieldScope: Per-image QA strings describe the original TEST curation stage; the current parent public-derivative approval is recorded above. No capture origin, time, correlation or report claim is changed.
